text:
maria (security): quick question — for the new private deploy testbed (eu-west) I want to propose an admin-plane segregation: an admin-proxy that handles auth and mTLS, a dedicated egress-only jump host for operator tasks, and KMS-only key wrapping for secrets. will this require RBAC changes to service accounts we already have?

jon (eng-infra): we have a prototype of an admin-proxy (oauth2-proxy + mTLS) but currently our bootstrap flow creates a ClusterRoleBinding that grants cluster-admin to argocd-bootstrap-sa. that will need to be scoped down.

jon (eng-infra): example change we discussed:
```yaml
# reduce blowfish permissions during bootstrap
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: argocd-bootstrap-binding
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: argocd-bootstrap-limited
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: argocd-bootstrap-sa
  namespace: infra
```

sasha (eng-sre): +1 to scoping the bootstrap role. also, networkPolicies need to block admin-plane from talkin to inference pods. keep admin-proxy on a separate namespace + hostNetwork=false.

sasha (eng-sre): quick NetworkPolicy snippet we can apply to inference ns:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-admin-from-inference
  namespace: inference
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: internal-services
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.20.30.0/24
```

dave (eng-runtime): note: ensure admin-proxy is not in the critical path for KV cache retrieval. we should permit a short direct path for inference runtime to cache store, while admin ops go through proxy. otherwise latency spikes.

cheng (ops): on KMS: we need envelope encryption with customer-managed keys. HSM-backed wrapping key + per-cluster data keys rotated monthly. also audit logs must be write-once and forwarded to our S3 retention bucket with immutability flag. who owns the forwarder?

maria (security): @cheng (ops) can you confirm the forwarder will sign logs and push with SSE-KMS? compliance wants proof of chain-of-custody (hashes).

cheng (ops): yes — forwarder will sign and push, using SSE-KMS. we will add SHA256 hashes to the manifest.

auditor-bot: Reminder: compliance.control.7.2 Audit Log Retention must be >= 7 years for eu-west regulated customers.

maria (security): vuln triage note: we found an old dependency in the admin-proxy image (python requests 2.22) flagged for CVE-2018-18074. we should rebuild the image + run SBOM check.

jon (eng-infra): I can rebuild and update image tag to sha256:... will run container-scan in pipeline.

maria (security): for incident response: if a control-plane compromise is suspected, playbook should:
- revoke admin-proxy certs (KMS-wrapped)
- rotate bootstrap SA tokens
- isolate control plane network (apply deny-all NP)
- preserve audit logs (immutable copy)

sasha (eng-sre): add: cut traffic to inference pods from control plane and failover to read-only model shard.

maria (security): tentative plan of record / action items:
1) jon: create RBAC PR to reduce bootstrap role + add CI gate (SBOM & scan) — due EOD +3
2) cheng: implement signed log forwarder with SSE-KMS + manifest hashes — due EOD +7
3) dave: validate runtime path to ensure cache bypass not proxied — due EOD +4
4) sasha: merge NetworkPolicy deny-all templates into infra repo + playbook for emergency isolation — due EOD +2
5) maria: draft incident response checklist & escalate matrix — due EOD +1

jon (eng-infra): created ticket INFRA-3218 and pushed a branch, will tag in the PR when ready :shipit:

deploy-bot: deploy status: no active deploys in inference cluster. last deploy 2123456000 by @jon (eng-infra) — all clear.

maria (security): thanks all. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :lock:
